question_text: Fill in: 'Neither the president nor the board members ___ in favor of the proposal.'

hint_ladder.title: Orient
hint_ladder.text: This sentence uses the 'neither...nor' pairing. The verb doesn't just follow the first subject—it agrees with the subject closest to it.

hint_ladder.title: Rule
hint_ladder.text: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. Isipin mo parang mas pinapakinggan ng verb 'yung pinakamalapit na subject.

hint_ladder.title: Apply
hint_ladder.text: Subjects: 'the president' (singular) and 'the board members' (plural). Ang verb malapit sa 'board members', kaya plural dapat.

hint_ladder.title: Nearly Give Away
hint_ladder.text: Options: 'is', 'was', 'has been' are singular. Only 'are' is plural. Match sa plural 'board members'.

A.text: You might have chosen A because 'president' is singular, but 'neither...nor' makes the verb agree with the nearer plural 'board members'.

B.text: Correct. 'Are' agrees with the plural 'board members' nearest the verb, per the 'neither...nor' rule.

C.text: You might have chosen C because 'was' is a verb, but it's singular and past tense—the verb must be plural present to agree with 'board me...

D.text: You might have chosen D because 'has been' sounds formal, but it's singular and perfect tense; the sentence needs a simple plural present...

next_time_rule: For 'neither...nor' or 'either...or', the verb agrees with the nearest subject. Ignore the other subject—it's the malapit, not malayo.
deconstruct_text:
Imagine a barangay budget meeting: 'Neither the captain nor the councilors ___ in favor.' The blank verb needs to match the subject right next to it. Ganito ang turo ni Ate: huwag kang magpa-pressure sa unang subject.

With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Dito, 'councilors' (plural) ang malapit, kaya plural verb. Options: 'is' (singular), 'are' (plural), 'was' (past singular), 'has been' (present perfect singular). 'Are' lang ang plural.

Mental trick: Isipin ang verb bilang batang makulit na sumusunod lang sa pinakamalapit na tao—hindi sa nasa dulo ng 'neither...nor'. Kaya sagot: 'are'. Pag nakasimba ka ng ganitong tanong, yung pinakamalapit lang ang paniwalaan.
